models.name: Anthropic — AI-native SDLC playbook
models.summary: A playbook of plays across six stages in which each stage commits an artifact (intent.md, spec.md, plan.md, PR, incident record) that triggers the next, with humans approving at the gates.
models.source_phases: Plan · Design · Build · Test · Deploy · Maintain

members.responsibility: Describes the problem to Claude in their own words and corrects the resulting intent.md.

members.responsibility: Reviews and corrects intent.md, approves it, and reviews and signs off spec.md.
